headline: Eight. The cloud keeps the sun.
body: The drizzle has stepped aside and left the pavement dark. Sixteen degrees under a full lid, wind out of the west at fourteen. The lamps have conceded; the sun is above the stack and not showing.

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: pavement still dark, bins not in

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: sun up, nowhere to be seen
